newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom confirms loses Lufthansa business.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom confirms loses Lufthansa business.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Telekom AG on Monday confirmed it had lost national airline Lufthansa AG as a phone customer.
Confirming a report in newsweekly Focus, Telekom said Lufthansa was switching over to Viag Interkom GmbH, a telecommunications venture between utility Viag AG and British Telecommunications Plc.

Lufthansa in June began using Viag Interkom for locations in Frankfurt, Hamburg, Berlin, Munich and other large cities, and would use that carrier exclusively by the end of 1998, a spokesman for the airline said.
The business was worth tens of millions of marks (dollars), Focus reported in an article that appeared on Monday.
